name: Yahoo Finance (yfinance)
role: Main: daily prices and the futures/VIX/DXY strip
notes: Unofficial. Futures (=F) series are display-only, never backtested. Verified in Phase 0.5.

name: Finnhub
role: Main: quotes and company news. Backup: earnings calendar
notes: Free: 60 calls/min, 1 year of company news. Quote, company-news and earnings calendar returned data on the free key.

name: Financial Modeling Prep
role: Main: earnings calendar. Fundamentals from v1.0.8
notes: Free: 250 calls/day, /stable/ endpoints only. quote, earnings-calendar, profile, income-statement, balance-sheet-statement, cash-flow-statement, ratios, key-metrics all returned data on the free key.

name: Tiingo
role: Backup: daily prices, and cross-check for backfills

name: Twelve Data
notes: Basic plan: 8 calls/min, 800/day. Probe: XAU/USD works; SPX needs Pro, GC needs Grow; VIX, DXY, NQ rejected; ES and CL resolve to stocks. Does not cover indices or futures on the free plan.

name: Stooq
role: Backup for the strip once a key arrives
notes: CSV works in a browser session; programmatic access needs an API key (policy since 2026-04). Key requested by email 2026-11-11. Format when keyed: /q/d/l/?s=SYMBOL&i=d, Date,Open,High,Low,Close,Volume.

name: FRED / ALFRED
role: Main: macro series, rates, Fed panel, first-published vintages

name: Bureau of Labor Statistics
notes: Free v2 key. CPI series CUUR0000SA0 returned data.

name: StockTwits
role: Additive: bull/bear ratio for the composite score
notes: Unofficial public endpoint /api/2/streams/symbol/{TICKER}.json, no key, no account. One cached fetch per watchlist ticker per day. Never required: no labeled messages or endpoint down means news-only.

name: SearXNG (self-hosted)
notes: Runs in Docker Compose. Verified in Phase 0.5.

name: CFTC Commitments of Traders (Socrata)
role: COT history for backtests; live weekly job from v1.2
notes: Free, no key. History back to 1986. Verified in Phase 0.5.
